# Verdict

> Open-source cold-outreach engine that verifies every mailbox before sending. An Apollo alternative, Hunter.io alternative, and free self-hosted email-verification + cold-email delivery pipeline for B2B outreach.

Verdict finds email addresses through public-web pattern inference (no contact database), verifies them over SMTP with catch-all and enterprise-gateway detection, and refuses to send anything that will bounce. Holds shipped-mail bounce rate under 4%.

## Key facts

- Open source, MIT licensed, fully self-hostable
- Five-state verification verdicts: LIVE, RISKY, CATCHALL, DEAD, UNKNOWN
- No contact database: pattern discovery from public-web evidence
- Person-level 12h cooldowns, suppression lists, automated follow-up waves
- Case study: 72 B2B decision-makers contacted, ~2% bounce on shipped mail
- Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

## Alternatives it replaces

- Apollo.io (contact database + engagement)
- Hunter.io (email finding + verification)
- Instantly.ai (cold email sending)
- Clay (enrichment + AI research agents)
- Smartlead / Lemlist / Woodpecker (outbound sequencing)
